package main

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-lib/adapters/kv"
	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-lib/lib/note"
	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-lib/testhelper"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	memory := testhelper.NewMemoryStore()
	value := note.New("Deadcode Consumer", "public surface")
	service := note.NewService(memory)
	_ = note.Slug(value.Slug)
	_ = note.NamespacedKey("notes", value.Slug)
	_ = service.Save(ctx, value)
	_, _ = service.Load(ctx, value.Slug)
	_ = memory.Save(ctx, value.Slug, value.Body)
	_, _ = memory.Load(ctx, value.Slug)
	redis := kv.NewRedisStore("127.0.0.1:6379")
	_ = redis.Save
	_ = redis.Load
	_ = redis.Close
}
